body.statement: If the same conditions hold with \(\rho=0\), then \[\frac{\widehat\tau_n-\tau_n}{\sqrt{\widehat V_{\mathrm{CR2},n}}}\rightsquigarrow\mathcal N(0,1)\] under \(N_n/n\to0\), with no condition on \(N_n^2/n\). This replaces the whole-tuple birthday condition in FuSamiiWang2026, Theorems 1--2, by the statistic-specific predictable-variation condition and includes sequences such as \(N_n=n^{3/4}\), for which \(N_n^2/n\to\infty\).
body.justification: Scalar PAME inference needs a vanishing sampling fraction, not a vanishing whole-tuple collision probability.
body.gap: FuSamiiWang2026 imposes the birthday-scale restriction \(N_n^2/n\to0\) because its proof couples the entire group tuple, while this theorem targets only the scalar statistic.
body.consumer: Experiments grouping \(n^{3/4}\) of \(n\) eligible units obtain justified CR2 inference despite failure of whole-design coupling.
